Tarikh Episode 1026 | 23 July 2025
In this episode of Tareekh, we explore the life of one of the most complex figures of the 20th century—J. Robert Oppenheimer. A brilliant physicist, a conflicted soul, and the man who led the Manhattan Project—the journey of Oppenheimer goes far beyond science. From a troubled childhood to Cambridge controversies, from poetic musings to political witch-hunts, and from quoting the Bhagavad Gita at the nuclear test site to opposing the hydrogen bomb—Oppenheimer's story is a fascinating mix of genius and guilt.
